Once again we missed our middle order runners (ill, buying houses and injured) and then we had Roger Alsop, Kevin Nash, Alex Hutchinson and Clive Gilby in action at Cardiff the following day so had to go back to the 60s to close in.
This year, with Jim Estall and Ray Foley running so well and with Kevin Nash expected to take part we thought we had a really good start in the men's event.

At last we were able to see what Kevin Nash is made of — and we like it. This young man's got great talent and at not quite 22 years of age we look forward to many more outings from him in the future.
It was good to see Alex Hutchinson racing for Belgrave and with Kevin Nash and Roger Alsop to back up, an unlooked for team win came our way.

Lee Hurst turned in his usual first class performance and newcomer Kevin Nash looked the part as he won the 'B' event. The match was well and truly won by the time the relays came round, which was just as well, as a combination of injuries and tiredness ensured that no records were in danger.
